name: 未明空间 (Weiming Kongjian / "wmkj")
english_description: The archive is labeled "Weiming Kongjian," but once connected the game actually identifies itself as "Jianghu Fengyun: Sunset Reappears" — a branch of the "Sunset Reappears" (Xi Yang Zai Xian) engine family that shares lineage with this collection's xyzxfk and jhfy, though each was developed independently rather than being a simple reskin. It belongs to the true "Sunset Reappears" bloodline alongside this collection's xyzx, jhfy3, xajh4gkb, and xyzxyl201412 — notably distinct from another group of archives here that carry the same brand name but actually descend from an unrelated "Tianya" codebase, a reminder that branding alone doesn't indicate lineage.
